description: Rubicon Research Limited operates as a specialty pharmaceutical company in India, the United States, and internationally. The company develops products in the areas of analgesics/pain management, cardiovascular system, central nervous system, hypokalemia, skeletal muscle relaxants, nicotine replacement therapy, gastrointestinal, metabolic, and immunosuppressant. Its primary proprietary technologies for drug delivery comprising RubiReten, a gastro-retentive system for drugs with poor solubility and a limited window of absorption, as well as RubiSRL for the formulation of sustained release liquids using a combination of ion exchange and membrane diffusion controlled-release technologies. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
